title: Giurgiu public-sector union protest against government austerity and frozen wages
participants_original: Approximately 100 union members, including police, prison-system police and public-administration workers
threshold_50_evidence: The report estimates about 100 participants, which supports the >=50 threshold qualitatively; the estimate is approximate, not an exact headcount.

start_date.summary: The article reports the physical protest on 10 February 2021.

organizer.summary: Participants are described as union members; no single organizer is securely identified.

demands.summary: Opposition to government austerity measures and frozen wages.

participants_original.summary: Approximately 100 union members across police, prison-system police and public-administration groups.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: About 100 reported participants supports the threshold, subject to the approximate count.

end_date.summary: Two-hour duration is reported, but no event start/end clock is given; end remains unknown.

protester_violence.summary: No event-specific violence finding is made from silence.

state_response.summary: Invitees did not attend the discussion or submit a memorandum; the counselor’s arrival alone does not establish negotiation or accommodation. Other response fields are unreported and unknown.

notes: AGERPRES reports a two-hour gathering opposing government austerity/frozen wages. Prefecture invitees did not attend the offered discussion or leave a memorandum; one counselor came down. This does not establish accepted negotiation or a formal accommodation. No exact start/end clock is reported.
open_questions: Exact physical start/end times and the seven event-specific response fields remain unresolved.

demands.summary: Opposition to removing free student transport.

title: Police protest in Piața Victoriei against austerity and personnel-pay policy
participants_original: A few hundred police from Bucharest and other parts of Romania.
threshold_50_evidence: The source describes a few hundred participants, supporting the >=50 threshold qualitatively; it is not a precise headcount.

start_date.summary: The article reports the physical protest on 16 February 2021.

organizer.summary: Police union demands are reported; a single named event organizer is not established.

demands.summary: Salary-law implementation, military pensions, inflation adjustment, bonus parity, meal allowance and working conditions.

participants_original.summary: A few hundred police from Bucharest and elsewhere in Romania.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: “A few hundred” participants supports the threshold qualitatively.

end_date.summary: About two hours is reported but no precise physical end clock is supplied.

protester_violence.summary: No event-specific violence finding is made from silence.

state_response.summary: The reviewed article does not establish any of the seven response fields; future plans are not outcomes.

notes: România Actualități reports a roughly two-hour police demonstration and demands concerning the salary law, military pensions, inflation adjustment, bonus parity, meal allowance and working conditions. A later gathering/march was only a future plan in this article and is not treated as a continuation. No exact start/end clock is given.
open_questions: The exact event end and event-specific state response remain unknown.

title: Police employees demonstrate at Cotroceni over government salary policy
location: Cotroceni, Bucharest; captions also refer to a mixed public-sector gathering near the Government building
participants_original: Police employees are described at Cotroceni; the broader mixed public-sector attendance at Cotroceni/Government is called “zeci” (tens/dozens), with no police-specific count.
threshold_50_evidence: The reported “zeci” applies to a mixed public-sector grouping and does not establish >=50 police participants. Photographs were not opened or inspected.

start_date.summary: The article reports the police-employee protest on 24 February 2021.

location.summary: The report identifies Cotroceni; captions also mention a mixed public-sector gathering near the Government building.

organizer.summary: Unionists are quoted, but the article does not establish a sole event organizer.

participants_original.summary: Police employees are described; broader mixed public-sector turnout is “zeci,” without a police-specific count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: The qualitative “zeci” count for a mixed gathering does not establish >=50 police attendees.

end_date.summary: No physical event end is established in the text/captions read.

protester_violence.summary: Lighting flares is reported; no evidence in the reviewed text establishes violence.

state_response.summary: Unionists allege gendarmerie actions; the gendarmerie denies a crush and states a safety/legal purpose. No arrest, beating, dispersal, accommodation, killing, shooting or protester violence is confirmed; keep coded response fields unknown.

notes: RFE/RL reports a police-employee demonstration over government salary policy and says flares were lit. Captions relay union allegations about gendarmes and quote a gendarmerie denial. Allegations, official statements and possible later fines are not converted into confirmed response fields; lighting flares alone does not establish protester violence.
open_questions: Police-specific attendance and whether the mixed gatherings are one event or more are unresolved.
Allegations about police/gendarmerie conduct are not independently confirmed; event-specific responses remain unknown.

title: Public miner solidarity gathering during the Valea Jiului wage stoppage
location: Valea Jiului / Petroșani area; exact public gathering site unresolved
participants_original: TVR says a few hundred miner coworkers protested outside in solidarity; it separately describes miners remaining underground.
threshold_50_evidence: The outside group is described as “câteva sute” (a few hundred), qualitatively above 50, but its timing/site and relationship to the underground stoppage need review.

start_date.summary: The article publication date is 19 February, but it does not establish the start date of the outside public gathering.

location.summary: A few hundred coworkers are described protesting outside in the Valea Jiului context; exact site of that public gathering is unresolved.

organizer.summary: The article describes miner coworkers and union leaders in the broader wage dispute; it does not establish the public gathering organizer.

demands.summary: The broader dispute concerns unpaid wages at state-owned CEH; whether the public gathering made a demand to national government remains unresolved.

participants_original.summary: A few hundred coworkers outside in solidarity; underground workers are described separately.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: “A few hundred” outside supports >=50 qualitatively, subject to confirming event/site boundaries.

end_date.summary: The article describes a broader stoppage response, but does not establish the outside gathering’s physical end.

protester_violence.summary: No event-specific violence finding is made from silence.

state_response.summary: Protocol, guarantees and government discussions are reported in the broader underground wage-stoppage context, not clearly tied to the public solidarity gathering; no accommodation is attributed to this candidate. Other fields remain unknown.

notes: TVR reports an outside solidarity gathering and separately reports an underground stoppage. It explicitly credits AGERPRES, so it is not independent corroboration. The reported protocol, government guarantees and minister/Prime Minister discussions concern the broader underground wage-stoppage context; available text does not clearly attribute those actions to the outside crowd. Wage arrears were owed by state-owned CEH; whether the public demand was directed to the national government remains an explicit eligibility question.
open_questions: Was the outside public gathering a distinct February event, and what was its exact start date/site?
Was its demand directed to the Romanian government or only the state-owned employer CEH?
Do not attach the underground negotiation/protocol/guarantees as accommodation to the outside gathering without episode linkage.
Payment completion and physical event end are not established.
